help_play: Play commands: You can play music in the video chat using the following commands. /play [song name/youtube url/reply to audio]: Play music in the video chat. /vplay [song name/youtube url/reply to video]: Play music video in the video chat. -f: Force play music in the video chat. -v: Plays music video in the video chat. /autoplay [on/off]: Enable or disable autoplay in the video chat. Example: /play -f -v attention
help_queue: Queue commands: /queue: Shows the currently queued tracks in the queue.
help_stats: Stats commands: /stats: Shows the bot's stats. /leaderboard: Shows the leaderboard of top users and groups.
help_sudo: Sudo commands: /ac: Shows the active calls count. /activevc: Shows the list of the active calls. /broadcast [reply to message]: Broadcasts the message to all the chats. -nochat: Excludes groups from the broadcast. -user: Include users in the broadcast. -copy: Removes the forwarded tag from the broadcast message. Example: /broadcast -user -copy /eval: Executes the given code. /logs: Sends the log file. /logger [on|off]: Enables/disables the logger. /restart: Restarts the bot. /addsudo: Add a user to the sudo users list. /rmsudo: Remove a user from the sudo users list.

bhelp_text:
**🛡 Mass Moderation Commands Help 🛡**

These commands allow you to quickly manage large numbers of users in a group.

**Basic Commands:**
• `/banall` - Bans all non-admin members in a group.
• `/kickall` - Kicks all non-admin members in a group.
• `/unbanall` - Unbans all banned users in a group.

**Advanced Filters (Optional):**
You can target specific types of users by adding a filter.
• `/banall bots` - Targets ONLY bots.
• `/banall deleted` - Targets ONLY deleted accounts.
*(Filters work with kickall and unbanall too)*

**Remote Execution:**
You can run these commands from the Bot's DM or another group by adding a Chat ID or Username!
• `/banall -1001234567890`
• `/banall @MyTargetGroup -test bots`

**Dry-Run Mode (Test):**
Want to see who will be affected without actually banning them? Use `-test`.
• `/banall -test`
• `/banall -test bots`

**Rules:**
- These commands must be sent directly in the group you want to manage.
- The Bot must have the `Ban Users` privilege.
- These commands are strictly limited to Sudo Users and the Bot Owner.
